naive_path: INT16 QK -> FP32 dequant -> causal mask -> F.softmax -> Q1.7 uint8 -> Batch_Head_u8s8s32_GeMM -> >>7 -> output requant -> INT8
iwhisper_path: INT16 QK + row max -> shift_exp_simd -> uint8 E + sum(E) -> pv_norm_requant_simd -> INT8
scope_note: Timing starts after QK score generation. It excludes Q/K/V projections and QK GEMM. I-Whisper row max is assumed available from the production fused QK-requant-rowmax kernel.
baseline_note: The direct Softmax baseline uses PyTorch FP32 Softmax and the repository's CPU Batch_Head_u8s8s32_GeMM helper. Therefore measured speedup reflects both the attention reform and the optimized fused SIMD implementation; it must not be described as reform-only speedup.
input_note: Dense kernels are benchmarked with deterministic synthetic QK/V values using actual model layer quantization parameters. Tensor shapes and dtypes match one autoregressive decoder self-attention step.
